source: USDA Agricultural Research Service, FoodData Central: SR Legacy (April 2018 release), public domain. Values per 100 g of the food as described.

statuses.usda: Values taken from the SR Legacy food named by its NDB number. Where SR Legacy has no figure for a nutrient (listed in gaps), the legacy figure is kept for that nutrient.
statuses.proxy: No SR Legacy entry is the same food, so the nearest one is used and named (dry breadcrumbs for panko, a pie crust made from flour and fat for shortcrust pastry, cured pork belly for pancetta, cured ham for gammon, light corn syrup for golden syrup, kidney beans for unnamed dried beans). Counted as sourced, with that caveat.
statuses.zero: Counted as nothing: water, colouring, flavourless or non-absorbed sweeteners, and bones used for stock and discarded.
statuses.generic: A deliberate stand-in for an unspecified ingredient (an unnamed spice, mixed herbs, a stock of unstated kind). The figure is a rough average with no single source.
statuses.unverified: No SR Legacy counterpart was matched. The figure is the hand-written legacy value, which has no recorded source.
